{{Quote|You know those large creatures we saw on the way in? The ''pardlam''?''"<br />"''They were hard to miss.''"<br />"''They're the main food source of the ''balyeg''. The pardlam are the only things on this planet big enough to sate its hunger, and it needs to eat a lot of them.|[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="BT1" />}}
The '''pardlam''' were creatures native to a [[Unidentified planet (balyeg)|planet]]. The [[balyeg]] preyed on the pardlam.<ref name="BT1" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Freighter/Legends|cargo ship]] [[Pardlam (starship)|''Pardlam'']] participated in the [[Battle of Shramar|battle]] of [[Shramar]].<ref name="Revelation 3">[[Invasion: Revelations 3|''Invasion: Revelations'' 3]]</ref>
